description_en: Queries Anti-DDoS Origin instances that have log analysis enabled
description_zh: 查询已开启日志分析的DDoS原生防护实例
name: ListOpenedAccessLogInstances

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource group to which the Anti-DDoS Origin instance belongs in Resource Management. By default, this parameter is empty, which indicates that the instance belongs to the default resource group.

For more information about resource groups, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例在资源管理服务中所属的资源组ID。默认为空，即属于默认资源组。

关于资源组的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/94485.html
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en: The page number to return in a paging query. Default value: 1, which indicates the first page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，返回第几页数据。默认值为1，表示返回第1页数据
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries to return on each page in a paging query. Default value: 10, which indicates 10 entries per page
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时，每页包含结果的数量。默认值为10，表示每页包含10个结果
parameters.name: page_size

SlsConfigStatus.description_en: The log analysis configurations of Anti-DDoS Origin instances
SlsConfigStatus.description_zh: DDoS原生防护实例的日志分析配置

Enable.description_en:
Indicates whether log analysis is enabled for the instance. Valid values:

true: Enabled.
false: Not enabled
Enable.description_zh:
该实例是否已开启日志分析。取值：

true：表示已开启。
false：表示未开启

InstanceId.description_en: The instance ID of Anti-DDoS Origin

TotalCount.description_en: The number of results returned, which is the number of Anti-DDoS Origin instances that have log analysis enabled
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询到的结果的数量，即已开启日志分析的DDoS原生防护实例的数量
